tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description: Search Waply public documentation. Returns at most five guides and never changes an account.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List Waply public guides with title, description, last update and URL per locale. Omit locale to get every published locale. Read-only.

tools.name: get_plan_details
tools.description: Read public Waply plan prices and terms. It does not start a trial or purchase.

tools.name: get_installation_guide
tools.description: Get the direct Waply installation link for Kommo and a short localized suggested response. For installation requests, lead with this clickable link; offer guideUrl only if the user asks for instructions or requirements. This tool does not install Waply or modify Kommo.

tools.name: list_meta_pricing_markets
tools.description: List the destination markets supported by Waply's WhatsApp cost calculator, with localized labels and exact IDs. Optionally search a country or regional group before calculating. Public information only.

tools.name: calculate_message_cost
tools.description: Estimate monthly WhatsApp message costs in USD using the same rate snapshot and calculation as Waply's web calculator. Choose current or October 2026 rates. Returns total, category breakdown and free service allowance. Meta costs only; excludes Waply plans, taxes and international authentication. Le

tools.name: compare_message_costs
tools.description: Compare the same monthly message volumes under the calculator's current and October 2026 Meta rate cards. Returns both USD totals, breakdowns and October-minus-current difference. Free-window traffic distribution is not inferred; this is the same comparison as the web calculator. Excludes Waply plan

tools.name: calculate_call_cost
tools.description: Estimate WhatsApp outgoing call costs from monthly minutes, using the same reference rate as Waply's web calculator. Incoming calls are free.
